metadata.description: Engineering skills for hardware, firmware and FPGA work. Each skill is a separate plugin.

plugins.name: hw-read
plugins.description: Read a KiCad or Altium hardware project from its project files into structured JSON: parts, nets, rules, stackup and layout geometry.

plugins.name: sch-review
plugins.description: Schematic review for KiCad and Altium projects: mechanical netlist checks plus a datasheet pass per IC. Needs hw-read.

plugins.name: emc-precheck
plugins.description: Port protection pre-check for KiCad and Altium boards: clamps, their ratings and placement, an HTML board view, and surge, burst and ESD pulse simulation of a port. Needs hw-read.

plugins.name: pcb-review
plugins.description: Layout review for KiCad and Altium boards: decoupling distance, differential pairs, reference planes, dangling tracks, edge and isolation distances, with an HTML board view. Needs hw-read.

plugins.name: hw-notes
plugins.description: Bilingual (EN/TR) commit messages and Redmine descriptions for Altium hardware repos, with work hour estimate.
